question: According to the project docs, what does this say: Discover → Fetch (Bronze): scope-filtered crawl; download raw files. Extract → Normalize (Silver): go-fitz / MuPDF (scanned PDFs via Vision…?
contexts: Discover → Fetch (Bronze): scope-filtered crawl; download raw files. Extract → Normalize (Silver): go-fitz / MuPDF (scanned PDFs via Vision OCR / EasyOCR, batched and cached); parse provision tree, validity, relations. Index (Gold): chunk by article + Qwen3-Embedding (ONNX FP16, 1024 dims) into pgvector. Hybrid retrieval — dense vectors + BM25 sparse vectors (sparsevec), RRF-fused with a query router, current-law pre-filter. Serve: AWS CloudFront → ECS on EC2 Graviton (in-process Qwen3-Embedding ONNX), same VPC as RDS (Singapore, PG17). Each domain's GET / serves a guide page; /mcp serves agents.
